description_en: Retrieves the list of Public DNS AppKeys
description_zh: 获取公共DNS AppKey 列表
name: DescribePdnsAppKeys

parameters.help_en: Specifies the language for the request and response. Valid values: zh for Chinese and en for English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；默认为 zh
parameters.name: lang

AppKeys.description_en: The list of Public DNS AppKeys
AppKeys.description_zh: 公共 DNS AppKey 列表

items.description_en: The information about a Public DNS AppKey
items.description_zh: 单个公共 DNS AppKey 的信息

AppKeyId.description_en: The ID of the Public DNS AppKey
AppKeyId.description_zh: 公共 DNS AppKey 标识

BindEdgeDnsClusters.description_en: The list of edge DNS clusters bound to the AppKey
BindEdgeDnsClusters.description_zh: 该 AppKey 绑定的边缘 DNS 集群列表

items.description_zh: 单个已绑定的边缘 DNS 集群

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the edge DNS cluster
ClusterId.description_zh: 边缘 DNS 集群 ID

ClusterName.description_en: The name of the edge DNS cluster
ClusterName.description_zh: 边缘 DNS 集群名称

ClusterUserId.description_en: The ID of the user to which the edge DNS cluster belongs
ClusterUserId.description_zh: 边缘 DNS 集群所属用户 ID

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the AppKey was created. The time is displayed in UTC+8 in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
CreateDate.description_zh: AppKey 创建时间，北京时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the AppKey was created, represented as a timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: AppKey 创建时间的毫秒时间戳

Remark.description_en: The remark entered when the AppKey was created or modified
Remark.description_zh: 创建或修改 AppKey 时填写的备注

State.description_en: The status of the AppKey. Valid values: OPENED: enabled. CLOSED: disabled
State.description_zh: AppKey 状态：OPENED 表示开启，CLOSED 表示关闭
